items: The server line on Now checks your provider without signing in, so it no longer says Not Answering when the server is fine.
Refresh finishes in about a second; your channel list updates in the background.
Where to Watch keeps every channel while the TV guide refreshes.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
